links.outcome: Robustness of LLM uncertainty scores to prompt variants and reproducibility across repeated runs
links.effect: Prompt-variant pairwise agreement ranged from 0.818 to 0.913. Repeat runs were identical for 29/30 Claude and 28/30 Gemini reports, so output was mostly but not fully reproducible.
links.quote: Reference-standard sensitivities yielded QWK: 0.810-0.841; prompt-variant pairwise agreement ranged from 0.818 to 0.913; repeat runs were identical for 29/30 Claude and 28/30 Gemini reports.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to grade linguistic uncertainty in radiology reports for auditing reporting language
Checking per-category recall because aggregate agreement can hide category-specific differences
Labeling a wording-based score as not valid for clinical risk triage

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (Claude Opus, Gemini Pro) for grading linguistic uncertainty in radiology reports using a retrospective benchmark dataset without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
